properties.c_1_description: Quaternal/QL lens: primordial question-space where archetypal number becomes epistemic act.
properties.q_0_number_as_archetype_ground: L0 is the home-register of the lens family's q_0 — the lens that IS ground, position #0 of the hexad, the aperture through which raw #0 (zero-dimensional total non-differentiation) first acquires epistemic posture (L0.md). Its thrown ground is the Jung-Pauli recognition won at the psyche-matter boundary: that the integers 1-6 are not abstract counters but PSYCHOID CHARGES — number as archetype before number as quantity. So L0's void-pole is the pre-quantitative integer: the count held before it counts anything, the archetype-number standing as pure qualitative charge prior to any application. This is the Quaternal lens because it reads through the four-fold-grounding-in-the-quaternity that Jung and Pauli found at the root of order itself — the psychoid layer where number and psyche are not yet two. L0 is the hinge 'where mute P-positions first become questions — the six questions ARE the six numbers in their epistemic mode' (L0.md): before a phenomenon asks what-am-I or how-do-I-work, it asks the barest epistemic question, which number is it being right now? This is the Why-lens — 'the question that returns to ground without expecting an answer. Aletheia before concealment' (L0.md): not why-causal (that is L1) but the originary opening-of-inquiry that posits there is something to be known at all. Per file-four L0 anchors the chromatic substrate at C/#0, the Archaic register, Truth as bindu — the irrepresentable ground given its first refraction. L0 is what knowing is before it has any mode but the bare posture of the question.
properties.q_1_the_quaternal_lens: What L0 IS: the Quaternal Lens, anchored on Jung-Pauli psychoid number (L0.md) — the epistemic mode in which any phenomenon is read as number-archetype, the integer carrying its own psychic charge before it is taken as quantity. Its substance is the recognition that the six positions #0-#5 are themselves the six fundamental number-archetypes in their knowing-mode: to look through L0 is to ask of a thing which of the archetypal numbers it is BEING. Where the other Day lenses read through a developed apparatus — L1 through causation, L2 through logic, L3 through process, L4 through lived experience, L5 through speech — L0 reads through the bare quaternal ground that under-lies them all, the four-fold-plus-implicate order that Jung named the quaternity and Pauli pursued into physics. It refracts P0 (Truth, the irrepresentable ground, bindu) and carries the element Aether (per L2'), the most rarefied medium, fitting for the lens of pure number-as-archetype. As member of Square A (the Speech-Number axis) L0 is the number-pole of the hexad's outer ring, bound to L5's speech-pole: 'number and Speech are the two extreme densities of the same self-articulating consciousness — at one pole, integers as archetypes carrying their own psychic charge' (Square A). What L0 IS, definitionally, is the lens that lets the field be known as the archetypal arithmetic it is made of: the mode of access in which #0-#5 are read as living numbers rather than mere positions.
properties.q_2_question_posing_dynamism: L0 moves by QUESTIONING and by GROUNDING-AS-NUMBER. Its dynamism is the opening-act: it does not answer, it poses — it is the lens whose operation is to turn a mute position into a live question, 'where mute P-positions first become questions' (L0.md). Where L1 commits to identification, L0 holds the question open; its motion is interrogative-recessive, returning every phenomenon to the ground-question (which number is it being?) without expecting that ground to answer in content. This is the Why-lens's characteristic pulse: Aletheia before concealment, un-concealment held open before it settles into any determinate disclosure. Relationally L0 couples to L5 across Square A's aetheric outer ring — the question (L0) and its manifest articulation (L5) as the two extreme densities of one self-articulating consciousness — and to its Möbius-partner L5' (Divine Logos) across the Day↔Night twist, so that the integer-as-archetype (Day) and the Logos-channel (Night) read one another. As the kernel's lens #0 (Archetypal-Numerical) it is the inaugural member of the first tritone-symmetric square (0,5), 'the void-and-fullness mirror' (kernel §Table C): paired with the Divine-Scalar/Vāk lens, L0 holds the void-pole of the lens-spectrum, the empty archetypal ground from which the fuller modes differentiate. L0's act, finally, is to keep the field perpetually re-questionable — the lens that refuses premature answer by returning everything to the number it is being.
properties.q_3_quaternity_structure: L0's organising structure is the quaternity — the four-fold-plus-implicate order Jung and von Franz found at the root of the archetype of number, and which file-four derives as the 4+2 itself (four explicate positions, two implicate poles, read at the lens-anchor). Structurally L0 sits in Square A (the Klein V₄ outer ring, P0+P5) as the number-corner, paired with L5 and mirrored by L0'/L5' — the aetheric tetrad where number-archetype and Vāk-speech bind the hexad at its extremes (Square A). In the kernel's lens-census L0 is lens #0 of the three tritone-symmetric squares, the descent-reading whose ascent-double is L0' (Archetypal-Numerical, the Night face); the pair (L0, L0') is the conjugate-doubling of the inaugural lens across the whole-tone double-cover. Its deeper structure is the psychoid identity of number and order: the quaternity is not a count of four things but the minimal structure in which order itself becomes thinkable — Jung's insight that 3+1 (the three-plus-the-fourth-that-completes) is the form every whole takes. L0 carries this as the structural ground beneath all the other lenses' apparatuses: before logic has its four lemmas (L2) or cause its four modes (L1), there is the quaternal order that makes any four-fold articulation possible. L0's form is number-as-the-grammar-of-order: the archetypal arithmetic that structures the field before any developed mode reads it.
properties.q_4_origin_question_telos: L0 exists to give the lens family its origin-question — so that every act of knowing begins from a ground-posture rather than mid-stream, and so that the field can always be returned to the barest epistemic demand: which archetypal number is this being? Its raison d'être is to be the Why-lens, 'the question that returns to ground without expecting an answer' (L0.md) — not the why-causal of L1 (which seeks a because) but the originary why that opens inquiry as such, the Aletheia-before-concealment that lets there be something to know before any mode determines how. Its genealogy is the first manifestation within the Lens family: raw #0 (Ground) → L0 (Quaternal), the inaugural application of epistemic refraction to the ground-archetype, anchored on Jung-Pauli's psychoid number. Its locality is the head of the L-spine and the number-pole of Square A's Speech-Number axis (Square A), refracting P0 (Truth, the irrepresentable bindu) — the lens stationed exactly where the field's most ineffable pole meets its first mode of access. L0 is why a phenomenon can be KNOWN-AS-QUESTIONED at all: the source-aperture every later lens presupposes, the mode that posits the field as interrogable before saying anything determinate about it. Its purpose is the opening itself — to be the lens through which the irrepresentable becomes, not represented, but questioned.
properties.q_5_question_returns_as_ground: L0 closes by being where the lens-family's Möbius LANDS as renewed question. As the number-pole of Square A — the hexad's Möbius cap — L0 is the partner across the twist to L5: the manifest articulation (L5, Para Vāk, the field spoken into world) returns through the Möbius P5→P0 to become L0's questioning-ground afresh (L5.md: the Möbius return is 'the structural pulse this lens makes audible'). So L0 is at once the family's first lens and the synthesis of its last: the question enriched by everything the speech-pole carried back. This enacts the matheme's 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the level of the originary lens — L0 (the question, the integer-as-archetype, the descent-face) and L5' (its Day↔Night Möbius-partner, the Divine Logos) are one aperture read from two faces, joined by the twist that makes manifest-speech return as un-asked silence-before-question. And L0 OPENS rather than concludes because the question is never finished being asked: tomorrow's ground is more than today's (the return is enriched, never identical), and the residual whole-tone η=log(9/8) keeps every archetypal number one step short of closing into final answer — each synthesis deposits a ground that the next inquiry must question anew. L0 is the lens that is never done opening: the originary question that the field's whole circuit returns to in order to begin again, the un-concealment that re-conceals just enough to leave the next knowing something to disclose.
